title: Barrier atlas of the four target conjectures
note: Uploaded by a second agent on Tubai's command, 20 October 2026, from a read-only study of the repositories strings, seed, 4Y-M, fermat-hodge- and H8. A wall is a proved no-go result with explicit hypotheses; a breaker is a construction that violates one of them. Status: established (proved in the cited source and reread here), conditional (rests on an unproved input), proposed (a route stated here, untested), open (no known method).

hodge.statement: HC is equivalent to (F2) and (F3'); (F2) is HC for abelian varieties, (F3') says every Hodge class is reached from abelian varieties. Algebraic loci are dense and either everything or meagre.
hodge.verdict: (F2) with (F3') is the conjecture itself, so no construction removes both at once. The first instances are finite questions. Three of the OpenAI inputs used by H8 Section 23 were withdrawn on 7 October 2026, so the sixfold, eightfold, K3 and Mumford deductions there are back to open; the standing inputs are (P1) CM abelian varieties and (P5) abelian covers, both unrefereed.

walls.statement: specialisation lifts only through semiregularity; a blow-up adds the defect of its centre; birational maps and Fourier-Mukai equivalences preserve the defect in degree 4
walls.breaker: construct a cycle outright on the variety carrying the class

walls.statement: direct sums are never semiregular
walls.hypothesis: the object is a direct sum
walls.breaker: convolutions (twisted complexes)

walls.statement: on E_0^6 the criterion dim Ext^2 = 57 fails for at most five line bundles, for six and seven, for eight outside 31 arrangements, for three powers of L and for threefold pieces of one family
walls.source: fermat-hodge-, Thm. fivebundles, Rem. sevenbundles, Prop. separated, Cor. threefolds
walls.hypothesis: few line bundles, or one family of supports
walls.breaker: eight or more line bundles, the 31 arrangements, supports mixing the two families; ranks along chains as certified exact linear algebra

walls.statement: chains of quotients by symplectic automorphisms have multiplier in {1, 2, 3, 6} modulo squares, so they reach no real multiplication outside sqrt 2, sqrt 3, sqrt 6
walls.source: fermat-hodge-, Prop. sqrt10 (Nikulin's coinvariant ranks 16 and 18)
walls.hypothesis: every correspondence is a symplectic quotient
walls.breaker: a correspondence of another kind: non-symplectic automorphisms, mixed groups

walls.statement: base change along finite subgroups of PGL_2 reaches only Q(zeta_7)^+ and Q(zeta_9)^+ with the algebra D_infinity
walls.hypothesis: the group acts on the base P^1
walls.breaker: an automorphism not fibred over P^1, or the transport map into the rank-18 family

walls.statement: composites of Hodge isometries between hyper-Kahler carriers return by +-1, and of similarities by a rational number
walls.breaker: a non-isometric correspondence; none is known

walls.statement: a Mumford fourfold has no degeneration keeping the exceptional class of Hodge type: its Hodge locus is a compact Shimura curve
walls.breaker: none

walls.statement: the link xi on X x X x Z_K is equivalent to the target together with one more cycle
walls.hypothesis: no cycle on X^r x Z_K acts on T_Z
walls.breaker: an algebraic cycle acting nonzero on T_Z; candidates at CM points from McMullen's curve (Mostaed, arXiv 2603.20268, 2816 equations)

walls.statement: very general Weil tori have Chern character exactly a Weil class, so the pure criterion (P2) is false
walls.breaker: the polarised form (P2'), whose rank is in closed form (H8, thm:p2primenumber)

walls.statement: the preprints 'Algebraicity of Weil classes on split abelian eightfolds' (18 Sep 2026, (P2)), 'Algebraicity of Kuga-Satake correspondences for K3 surfaces' (3 Oct 2026, (P3)) and 'The rational Hodge conjecture for products of K3 surfaces' (4 Oct 2026, (P4)) were withdrawn by their authors on 7 October 2026: a sign error in the stabilisation-trace argument gives a signed count I_new = -2m instead of 0, so the Eliashberg-Murphy cancellation and the oriented-surgery construction are unsupported; the notice does not assert the statements false
walls.source: openai/math history.md (7 Oct 2026) and the withdrawal notice in the eightfolds directory; the pre-withdrawal manuscripts are archived at revision adc7f124 and in creelie/math01-openai
walls.hypothesis: (P2), (P3) or (P4) is used as an input
walls.breaker: an independent proof of the statement used; until then every deduction from them (H8 thm:weilsix, thm:kspowers, cor:mumfordall, cor:k3all, prop:k3twosmall, thm:rmlocus closure) is a conditional statement with a withdrawn hypothesis

walls.statement: the secant-sheaf route proves algebraicity of the flat deformation of ch(E) only if E is semiregular; for CM fields of degree at least four Markman builds E on X x Pic^0(X) with real multiplication by F and states that the semiregularity of E has not been addressed; Voisin's survey of 12 Sep 2026 puts semiregularity as the limit of the method and says it is very unlikely to settle the variational Hodge conjecture in general
walls.source: Markman arXiv 2509.23079 (abstract), Voisin on Tao's blog 2026-09-12
walls.hypothesis: the carrier of the Weil class is a semiregular object of D^b(A)
walls.breaker: prove semiregularity for one explicit E (Jacobian of a genus-4 curve with real quadratic multiplication), or replace the sheaf by a hyperkahler carrier as Floccari-Fu and van Geemen-Rapagnetta do at discriminant 1

walls.statement: every hyperkahler carrier of a Weil fourfold known so far (singular OG6 of Floccari-Fu, the K3^[3]-type sixfold of van Geemen-Rapagnetta, the hyper-Kummer construction) reaches only discriminant 1; the Weil classes of other discriminants in dimension 4 are Markman's theorem alone, and in dimension 6 only the split type (discriminant -1) is known
walls.source: Floccari-Fu, J. Math. Pures Appl. 2026 (arXiv 2504.13607); van Geemen-Rapagnetta arXiv 2607.18341; Floccari-Fu arXiv 2607.07528; Markman arXiv 2502.03415
walls.breaker: a hyperkahler variety whose singular locus or Lagrangian fibration carries a Weil fourfold of nontrivial discriminant, or a Weil sixfold of nonsplit type; none is known

walls.statement: on McMullen's curve V in the Hilbert modular sixfold of L = Q(cos(pi/21)) the Weil locus W_K (codimension 3, twenty components) meets V in finitely many CM points with endomorphism field KL of degree 12; the Hodge-Weil classes there are absolute Hodge, and no algebraicity theorem covers them (isolated CM point, no K-secant structure, uncontrolled discriminant); for d in {3,7} non-emptiness is 2816 explicit equations at the prime 43
walls.hypothesis: the class lives at an isolated CM point of a Weil locus of codimension three
walls.breaker: (P1), if it stands, gives algebraicity at every CM point outright; otherwise solve the 2816 equations and apply a split polarisation (Saller, Theorem A) to land in Markman's split sixfolds

walls.statement: for a very general principally polarised abelian variety of dimension at least four every curve class is an even multiple of the minimal class, so the integral Hodge conjecture fails for abelian varieties; only rational multiples can be constructed
walls.source: Engel, de Gaay Fortman, Schreieder arXiv 2507.15704 v3 (March 2026), unrefereed
walls.hypothesis: an integral cycle representing the minimal class
walls.breaker: work rationally: a cycle with class in Q times the Hodge class is the target, and a certificate must allow a denominator

walls.statement: Fricke self-isogenies of elliptic K3 surfaces need genus-zero X_0(N); level 10 forces rho >= 20 and level 13 gives one K3 surface R13 with rho = 16 and CM endomorphism field (its Frobenius polynomial at p = 7 is not a norm from Q(sqrt13)); levels 5 and 7 give complex multiplication by Q(sqrt -5), Q(sqrt -7) on every member, real multiplication by sqrt 5, sqrt 7 only at van Geemen-Sarti's two fixed-point twists (fermat-hodge- v2.6.0 Thm V.9, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23490234); so the route gives real multiplication in families only by sqrt 2, 3, 6
walls.hypothesis: a self-isogeny of one elliptic fibration
walls.breaker: chains through different surfaces (Thm. chain) mixing a 2- or 3-quotient with a 5-isogeny, ending Hodge-isometric to the start

walls.statement: every integral homology class contains a mass-minimising integral current (Federer-Fleming), its mass is at least the calibrated volume (Wirtinger), and equality holds exactly for effective algebraic cycles (Harvey-Lawson, King, Chow); so the Hodge conjecture for a class alpha is the vanishing of the mass gap of e alpha + k h^p for one pair (e, k), and Kollar's very general threefolds in P^4 of degree divisible by l^3 show the multiplier e cannot be dropped; a mass-decreasing flow with surgery can reach the minimiser but not the equality case
walls.hypothesis: the argument only lowers the mass of an integral current in the class
walls.breaker: a proof that the minimiser is calibrated for some multiple e alpha + k h^p, which is the conjecture for alpha

walls.statement: for a smooth hypersurface F = sum f_i g_i the class of the complete intersection {f_i = 0} is an explicit residue of det Jac(f_1, g_1, ...) Omega / F^(m+1) (Villaflor Loyola 2022); the Hodge conjecture for the hypersurface follows when these residues and theta^m span Hdg^m, but deciding which elements of the Jacobian ring have rational residues needs their periods
walls.source: fermat-hodge-, paper/sec8_status.tex, Prop. VIII.3 (residues of complete intersections)
walls.hypothesis: cycles are produced only from decompositions F = sum f_i g_i
walls.breaker: a period computation showing the residues of all decompositions span Hdg^m for one non-Fermat family

walls.statement: hypotheses on zero-cycles force H^{n,0} = 0, and (F3') for every uniruled fivefold is equivalent to (F3') in degree four for every fourfold
walls.hypothesis: the construction uses only the decomposition of the diagonal
walls.breaker: a cycle on a fourfold with h^{4,0} or h^{3,1} nonzero

walls.statement: a product of varieties satisfying (F3') need not satisfy it: for a threefold X and a curve C the Hodge classes of H^3(X) x H^1(C) lie in Ab only if their weight-one images in H^3(X) are reached by algebraic correspondences, the generalised Hodge conjecture for level one
walls.hypothesis: h^{3,0}(X) nonzero and X not uniruled
walls.breaker: an Abel-Jacobi or isogeny cycle inducing the weight-one piece

walls.statement: (F3') in the middle degree of every even-dimensional variety gives every degree only with standard conjecture B: from a smooth complete intersection one reaches h^{n-2p} g, not g
walls.hypothesis: standard conjecture B unknown for X
walls.breaker: an algebraic inverse of hard Lefschetz on X, known for abelian varieties and members of A

walls.statement: Ab^p(X) is the set of Hodge classes in the sum of the images of H^*(B) under algebraic correspondences from abelian varieties, by semisimplicity; so with (F2), (F3') on X is the Hodge conjecture on X, and only a new cycle on B x X advances it
walls.source: fermat-hodge-, Prop. f3prime-known (i) and Prop. hc-split
walls.breaker: none

walls.statement: the algebraic locus of the Weil classes in D_F is a countable union of closed algebraic subsets (the loci of relative cycles of the components of the Chow varieties), so it is not meagre exactly when one of them is all of D_F, that is when a relative cycle over the generic member exists; density, CM points, Hecke orbits and escape sequences lie in the union and never force a component to be everything
walls.source: fermat-hodge-, Thm. main; H8 thm:escape; anaxia modlog run hodge-f2-dichotomy
walls.breaker: a relative algebraic cycle over D_F whose class on one member is the Weil class, which is (F2) for the family

routes.text: finish E_0^6 by certified brute force: quotient the configurations by the stabiliser of the CM point and by Galois, compute every rank modulo two primes, emit rank certificates (exact kernel vector plus a nonsingular minor), recheck in Lean
sweep the CM point as a parameter (E_{zeta_3}^6 and other CM types); the target 57 and the Ext dimensions change with it

Markman settles Weil fourfolds of every discriminant (arXiv 2502.03415), sixfolds of discriminant -1 for every imaginary quadratic field (2502.03415) and split sixfolds (2509.23403); for CM fields of degree >= 4 the object E of 2509.23079 is built but its semiregularity is open; the frontier is CM degree >= 4 off CM points, non-split eightfolds, n >= 5 and the exceptional classes; enumerate Mukai vectors on moduli of sheaves with K-action and screen against (P2')

for F = Q(zeta_7)^+ the Shimura curve of each algebra D lies in the four-dimensional period domain of the rank-18 family, whose image is a threefold; locate an intersection point numerically and certify it in ball arithmetic; a point gives (F3') at (F, D) beyond D_infinity
for each cyclic cubic field of conductor 13, 19, 31, ... search Nikulin gluings for a K3 lattice with a group action whose rational group algebra has that field as a centre and transcendental rank 9

no source of non-isometric correspondences on S_lambda x S_lambda is known beyond Kuga-Satake; the lowest Picard ranks where the Kuga-Satake map is realised are 14 (Poon, Math. Nachr. 2026: abelian eightfolds with definite quaternion multiplication) and 16 (Varesco, Michigan Math. J. 2025, v3 of arXiv 2203.09778 corrects an SO-invariant error in the totally real argument), and the Floccari-Fu genus-4 triple covers (arXiv 2310.11981) give a nine-dimensional family with Kuga-Satake algebraic; rank 9 with a cubic endomorphism field is covered by none, and (P3) is withdrawn

(P1), the OpenAI preprint 'The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties' (30 Sep 2026), is the one Hodge input still standing; it was produced outside the fixed procedure, has no Lean, is unrefereed, and is not withdrawn; if it stands, every CM member of every Weil family is covered, and by H8 thm:main (algebraic locus dense, all or meagre) (F2) for the family then needs one non-CM member or closedness of the locus; H8 thm:escape shows the CM points alone do not decide the dichotomy, so (P1) is a base-point supplier, not a closure

Jumagulov (arXiv 2608.18134, unrefereed) proves the Hodge conjecture for the Fermat fourfold of every odd degree m <= 199 by a machine census of the 78,299 Hodge (2,2)-orbits with Lean certificates; thirteen orbits outside Aoki's calculus are closed by a *-split criterion and level-lifted closures (m = 33 lifts to 66); an even-degree companion through degree 250 is submitted; by H8 thm:simplextype a smooth hypersurface of simplex type has its Hodge conjecture reduced to Fermat varieties of its lattice degree e, so the census closes every simplex-type fourfold with odd e <= 199 once the reduction's dimension bookkeeping is checked against it; the loop sextic (e = 2604) is out of range

Saller (github.com/sallerk/HC-cm-sixfolds, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23199503, 2026, unrefereed, AI-assisted) gives explicit split polarisations on CM sixfolds (Theorem A: every CM abelian variety with a Weil structure has a split polarisation; Theorem D: biquadratic L with multiplicities (2,1), (1,2), Hodge group of dimension 17), and the Hodge conjecture for powers of simple CM sixfolds conditional on Markman's split sixfolds; use the split polarisations as the CM base points of H8 thm:main at which Markman applies, and screen Theorem B's fifteen equality cases against the walls

Bloch-Esnault-Kerz split the variational Hodge conjecture into a formal step (a class on Artinian thickenings deforms iff it stays Hodge, proved under Chow-Kunneth; Morrow over K[[t]]) and an algebraisation step; Voisin names this as the step after semiregularity; no algebraisation result is known, so a route through it must produce the algebraisation for one explicit family

the etale cyclic triple covers of genus-four curves give abelian sixfolds of Weil type for Q(sqrt -3), n = 3, and at the explicit curve x^3 + y^3 + 1 + lambda x^3 y^3 = 0 the multiplication map H^0(K+eta) x H^0(K-eta) -> H^0(2K) is an isomorphism, so the Prym map is a local isomorphism onto the nine-dimensional Weil domain (Faber 1988 in general; fermat-hodge- Prop. VI.40, construct/genus_four_prym.py); this reaches the Weil sixfolds of one field and does not give (F2)

convolutions of the 128 Weil pieces on E_0^8 whose shifts lie in seven consecutive integers never meet the polarised criterion (threshold 104): 18 of the 28 arrangements by hand, 9 more by linear-programming bounds with least value 125.8 (fermat-hodge- Prop. VI.37, Cor. VI.38, Rem. VI.39); the arrangement with even shifts s, s-2, s-4, s-6 and odd shifts s-1, s-5 stays open (the bound vanishes on some distributions), as do wider arrangements

over twelve cubic fields no integral class of a sextic CM field has -chi <= 24 and chi lies in 8Z, so the dimension count excludes no object there (fermat-hodge- Rem. VI.41); the sextic case needs a different obstruction

strings.statement: GSC holds iff there is a viable vacuum (C1)-(C9) on a component that carries no standard embedding (Theorem D of strings, whose mirror clause is empty by construct/gsc_mirror_fixed.py).
strings.verdict: reduced to bare existence outside L^mu: a mirror-fixed vacuum has chi = 0 and no families, so the selected vacuum lies off every (2,2) component and the mirror condition of Theorem D drops; what is left, one vacuum with (C1)-(C9) off the standard-embedding components, is blocked by definition, since (C7)-(C9) are fixed by comparison with measurement and no published model establishes all three.

walls.statement: the standard embedding gives 100/|H| net families on quintic quotients and never three on the three weighted pencils or their free quotients
walls.breaker: non-standard bundles (line-bundle sums, monads) or other Calabi-Yau threefolds

walls.statement: a vacuum in L^mu fixed by mu is isomorphic to its mirror, so h^11 = h^21 and chi = 0; its component contains a (2,2) point, so c_3(V) = chi = 0, the index c_3/2 vanishes on every free quotient, and (C2) fails; hence no viable vacuum is mirror-fixed, and GSC is equivalent to the existence of one viable vacuum outside L^mu, with no mirror condition (also in the compact-group reading); a viable vacuum of standard type, if one exists, is never selected
walls.source: construct/gsc_mirror_fixed.py (lemma, corollary, data check on self-mirror and three-family Hodge pairs); Theorem D and the mirror-pairs remark of strings
walls.hypothesis: L^mu is the union of the standard-embedding components and mu sends a vacuum to one whose threefold is a mirror
walls.breaker: none: every viable vacuum lies outside L^mu, where the clause is empty; the existence statement itself is the open part

walls.statement: moduli stabilisation, the Yukawa hierarchy and supersymmetry breaking are fixed by comparison with measurement
walls.breaker: definition repair (construct/reformulate.py): each condition as an explicit inequality

walls.statement: numerical Calabi-Yau metrics (Donaldson's algorithm, neural networks) carry no certified error bound, so (C8) is checked numerically and not proved
walls.source: cymetric; Constantin, Fraser-Taliente, Harvey, Lukas, Ovrut, arXiv 2402.01615
walls.breaker: an a posteriori bound on the Monge-Ampere residual

walls.statement: the positive two-term monads with three net families on free quotients of the quintic are exactly two (rank 3 on X/Z5, rank 5 on X/(Z5 x Z5), the latter on the Dwork pencil with anomaly saturated); neither breaks its GUT group to the Standard Model group
walls.source: Braun 0909.5682; Anderson-Gray-He-Lukas 0911.1569; reproduced by construct/monads.py, with the Z5 x Z5 map checked surjective at 600 sampled points of two Dwork members
walls.hypothesis: positive two-term monad on a quintic quotient
walls.breaker: line-bundle sums on CICYs with h11 >= 2 (Anderson-Gray-Lukas-Palti), extension bundles, non-positive monads

walls.statement: no published heterotic vacuum establishes (C7), (C8) and (C9) together: the flavour fits of Constantin, Leung, Lukas and Nutricati (2507.03076, Phys. Rev. D 2026) reproduce quark and lepton masses and mixing in line-bundle models with 50 to 80 free parameters and no moduli stabilisation; stabilisation studies (Gray-Wang 1906.09373) fix some complex-structure moduli at the price of spectrum jumping; supersymmetry breaking is not computed in either
walls.hypothesis: GSC proved by exhibiting a vacuum
walls.breaker: one model with all nine conditions computed and bounded; under the windows of construct/vacuum_conditions.py this is a multi-month computation, not a proof step

routes.text: write (C7)-(C9) as inequalities, then scan: CICY and Kreuzer-Skarke threefolds, free quotients, line-bundle sums with c_1 = 0 (cohomCalg, pyCICY), stability as linear feasibility in the Kahler cone, index -3|Gamma|, Wilson lines, spectrum, then numerical Yukawas with error bars (cymetric)

the SU(5) monad O(1)^5 + O(2)^5 -> O(3)^5 on the Dwork quintic modulo Z5 x Z5 gives three net families (index -75, c2(V) = c2(TX)), so the Dwork pencil itself carries (C1)-(C2) off the standard embedding; it fails (C3), so the pencil needs non-positive monads or extensions to go further

take the existing line-bundle standard models (AGLP 1106.4804, 1202.1757; the SU(5) scan of Constantin et al.) that pass (C1)-(C6) and test them against the repaired (C7)-(C9); this is the shortest path to one viable vacuum, which Theorem D makes equivalent to GSC

LAST-STEP BYPASS, not a closure: accept a published three-family model as satisfying (C7)-(C9) by the physics literature's own standard. GSC then follows by Theorem D, but the result is conditional on those unproved physical inputs, and must be labelled conditional

SU(5) line-bundle sums on the tetraquadric P1^4[2,2,2,2] (construct/lbs_tetraquadric.py): with entries in [-2,2], 372 sums pass c1 = 0, the anomaly, polystability at an explicit Kahler point and index -3|G| for |G| in {2,4,8}; 228 pass the exact upstairs spectrum (no anti-10s, a Higgs 5-5bar pair), from line-bundle cohomology computed by the Koszul sequence and checked against the index and Serre duality on all of [-2,2]^4; these form 10 classes up to permuting the factors (4 for |G| = 2, 6 for |G| = 4). With the free Z2 that swaps the coordinates of every P1, all line bundles are equivariant and a Wilson line diag(1,1,1,-1,-1) breaks SU(5) to the Standard Model group, so (C3) holds at the group level. Still to check: the G-action on cohomology (downstairs spectrum, (C5), (C6))

definition repair proposed in construct/vacuum_conditions.py, every number for Deep to accept or edit: (C7) every modulus has mass >= 30 TeV; (C8) at mu = 2e16 GeV the up, down and lepton Yukawa matrices have rank 3 and singular-value ratios within a factor 3 of the MSSM tan(beta) = 10 GUT-scale values (u/t 6.5e-6, c/t 3.2e-3, d/b 8.7e-4, s/b 1.6e-2, e/tau 2.8e-4, mu/tau 5.9e-2; Xing-Zhang-Zhou 0712.1419), |V_us| in [0.15, 0.30]; (C9) some F-term nonzero and gravitino mass in [1 TeV, 1000 TeV]. The checker is numeric and labels a pass numeric, never proved

after construct/gsc_mirror_fixed.py the whole of GSC is: does a vacuum with (C1)-(C9) exist on a component with no standard embedding. (C1)-(C4) hold in the heterotic standard models (BHOP05, BD06, AGLP11-12), (C5)-(C6) in some line-bundle models, so GSC is equivalent to one of those models, or another, meeting (C7)-(C9); no proof route exists until (C7)-(C9) are inequalities (c7-c9-proposal), and then the route is repair-then-scan

seed.statement: the exact transition depth D_4 of the Kreuzer-Skarke list; 22 <= D_4 <= 346 (relative to the supplied census), D = 349 uniformly, D_2 = 5, D_3 = 11.
seed.verdict: closable by brute force with certificates.

walls.statement: a bound using only (|Delta|, |Delta*|) cannot be below the longest chain of realised pairs, 348
walls.breaker: strictly monotone invariants added as keys: the normalised volumes of Delta and Delta* (construct/volume_chain.py)

walls.statement: in dimension 3 the h*-vector is palindromic and vol Delta = 2|Delta| - 6, so the volume adds nothing
walls.breaker: in dimension 4, vol Delta = |2 Delta| - 3|Delta| + 2 depends on h_2

walls.statement: exact depth needs the maximal reflexive subpolytopes, exponential in the number of points
walls.breaker: cut chains with interval Hasse diagrams (hcert), symmetry reduction, best-first search

walls.statement: exact transition depth by breadth-first search through complete covers costs about 50 s per cover list at 37 lattice points (PALP 2.21, one core), and the certificate for depth 22 needed 5,592 polytopes; a depth-23 search from the 57-point polytope of the Delta-680 descent is a farm job
walls.breaker: the device farm with a cover cache keyed by PALP normal form

routes.text: finish the threshold-50 farm (11,315,601 certified, 18,681 left at the time of reading), then rerun hcert on the remainder at T = 40, 30, 22
compute |2 Delta| for the whole list on the device (the Hugging Face copy has no volume field) and run chain_bound3; the 106 polytopes with pair bound above 340 may drop without a cut search
local search over weight systems near (8,4,2,1,1) and skew bipyramids scored by the exact shortest descent on small cases
re-verify reflexivity and point counts of the certificates with Normaliz or the integer-only reflexive.py, so D_4 does not rest on PALP alone

search for depth 23 beyond skew bipyramids: the 57- and 78-point polytopes of the Delta-680 descent (upper bounds 23 and 24), and weight systems near (8,4,2,1,1), with exact depth by parallel BFS and a normal-form cover cache
restrict the pair and volume chains to end at pairs realised by r-minimal polytopes; valid because every descent ends at an r-minimal polytope

exact-depth breadth-first search from Gamma8 (57 points, depth <= 23) started on 2026-10-20 with the seed repository's complete covers and PALP; level 1 took 264 s on four cores. Depth 23 there would prove D4 >= 23

yang-mills.statement: Hypothesis R: a positive mass gap of 4D SU(2) lattice Yang-Mills uniformly in the spacing.
yang-mills.verdict: window widening only; problems 2 to 4 of 4Y-M (crossover, continuum limit, physical gap) are the Clay problem.

walls.statement: any forest gauge leaves at least 2(d-1)(abar-1) = 12 active partners per active link on average, so single-link Dobrushin with the quarter influence stops at beta_W = 1/3
walls.breaker: blocks of links; plaquette variables with Bianchi constraints; Dobrushin-Shlosman on boxes

walls.statement: the SU(3) single-link corrector stops near beta_W = 0.77
walls.breaker: multi-link blocks

walls.statement: the gauge Dobrushin-Shlosman test needs a box of side about 90, about 2.6e8 SU(2) links
walls.breaker: rigorous bounds on small blocks instead of one large box

walls.statement: the multiscale log-Sobolev route needs convex effective potentials along the Polchinski flow; none is known for gauge fields at order-one coupling
walls.source: Bauerschmidt, Bodineau, Dagallier, Probab. Surveys 21 (2024); 4Y-M OPEN.md
walls.breaker: gauge-fix first, then prove convexity (unknown)

walls.statement: the crossover to Balaban's regime, the continuum limit with the Osterwalder-Schrader axioms and the gap in physical units
walls.breaker: none known

walls.statement: blocks of at most 9 active links move the estimated block-Dobrushin crossing only to about 0.35 (plaquette) and 0.37 (3-cube); the unit 4-cube (24 links) has no measured crossing up to beta_W = 0.40
walls.source: bllm/ym_blocks.py scout: synchronous transport coupling, overhead 1.13 at b = 0, sampled boundaries
walls.breaker: the unit 4-cube block or Dobrushin-Shlosman boxes

routes.text: blocks of 4 links (a plaquette) or the links of a unit cube; bound the Wasserstein influence of a boundary link on the conditional block law by interval quadrature on SU(2)^k with Lipschitz enclosures; check a weighted Dobrushin norm below 1 at a rational beta; verify the inequality in Lean; start at beta_W = 0.35
weighted Dobrushin and matrix-norm criteria gain only when influences vary; in the one-per-plaquette gauge every link has 12 partners, so the gain is expected to be small
enter the beta ranges of Cao, Nissim and Sheffield (arXiv 2505.16585), Shen, Zhu and Zhu (arXiv 2204.12737) and Adhikari and Cao (Ann. Probab. 2025) as calibration nodes
Faizal and Shabir (arXiv 2606.19362) claim a 4D SU(N) construction with a mass gap; unrefereed and unverified, kept out of the ledger

certify the unit 4-cube block at beta_W = 0.36 first (scout margin about 15%), then 0.38 and 0.40: rigorous W1 bounds for the conditional block law by interval quadrature or a certified coupling, an adversarial search over boundary conditions as the refuter, and the final rational inequality in Lean

port the degree-2 corrector of the SU(3) proof (gauge-fixed/su3.md) to SU(2): it breaks the quarter-influence hypothesis that has no breaker in the ledger; the expected gain is small (SU(3) single-link limit about 0.77 against 3/4)
